name: runtests
description: Run a Julia package's Runtests test items from the Test Explorer

runtests.julia.executable.markdownDescription: The `julia` that runs the server. Empty: the Julia extension's `julia.executablePath`, or `julia` on the `PATH`.

runtests.julia.args.markdownDescription: Arguments given to `julia` first, such as `+1.12` to pick a juliaup channel.

runtests.monorepo.markdownDescription: Serve the folder as a workspace of several packages, with `Runtests.serve_mono`: their items in one tree, under a node for each package, and runs as combined runs. `auto`: when the folder's `Project.toml` lists workspace members other than its own `test`. The server restarts when this setting, or the folder's `Project.toml`, changes the choice.

runtests.environment.markdownDescription: The environment the server runs in, relative to the workspace folder; it must have Runtests. Empty, for a folder of one package: `test` when `test/Project.toml` exists, the folder itself otherwise. Empty, for a workspace of several packages: the first of the root's `test`, the root and each member's `test` that has Runtests in `[deps]`.

runtests.run.options.markdownDescription: Settings sent with every run, such as `{"workers": 2}`: any of the `run` command's options in the editor protocol. Everything else comes from `test/TestItems.toml`, or the file `#runtests.config#` names.

runtests.config.markdownDescription: A config file to read in place of `test/TestItems.toml`, relative to the workspace folder, for listing the items and for every run. Empty: `test/TestItems.toml`. Read when the server starts: run `Runtests: Restart Server` after changing it. Not used for a workspace of several packages: each package reads its own `test/TestItems.toml`.
